The formula f* = (bp − q)/b is adapted to incorporate an inferred fair probability from edge scores and implied odds. The confidence gate ensures that only high-confidence picks are considered, preventing spurious bets. The stake unit cap prevents overexposure from any single pick, aligning with variance-reduction practices in professional sports betting. Dualities emerge between theoretical optimality and practical robustness, with failure modes including zero-edge scenarios and threshold violations. The system avoids recommending actual bets, emphasizing stake sizing as a tool for informed decision-making.
